description: Ministry of Higher Education and Highways - Order to amend by adding "(f) Dept. of English Language and Teaching "  to the South Easter University act that published in the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 916/07 of 1996.03.27
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an order made under statutory powers (Section 27(1)) to amend the schedule establishing the South Eastern University of Sri Lanka by adding a new Department of English Language Teaching. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory nature of the content, which focuses on modifying the legal framework governing universities rather than detailing the minister's portfolio responsibilities or making personnel changes.
